author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices hand placement, down-and-up patterns, holding long notes, same and new phrases, and soft-to-bright playing together, with Grieg's sunrise music.

classes.title: Wake up, little hand
classes.goal: Find C by the two black keys and wake the right hand up on it.

mathTarget.parentLine: C always sits just left of the two black keys

classes.parentPrompt: Stretch and yawn together, then help your child rest the thumb on C.
classes.childAction: Big yawn, stretch your fingers, then curve them with thumb on C.
classes.bridge: C is the bed, just left of the two black keys; the hand wakes there.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding C and placing the hand.

classes.title: Down the valley, up again
classes.goal: Play the first line: it walks down to C, then climbs back up to E.

mathTarget.parentLine: Down to the bottom, then back up the same steps

classes.parentPrompt: Draw a valley in the air with your finger as your child plays, down then up.
classes.childAction: Play G, E, D, C down, then D, E back up.
classes.bridge: The tune rolls down into a valley at C, then climbs out to E.

intro.caption: Down the valley, up the hill
intro.parentCue: draw a valley shape in the air

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a tune going down and coming back up.

classes.title: The sun climbs higher
classes.goal: Hear the second part climb to the highest note, then walk home to C.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune climbs to its highest note, then comes down

classes.parentPrompt: Raise your hand slowly like the sun as the notes climb; lower it at the end.
classes.childAction: Play your part and point up at the highest note.
classes.bridge: Notes to the right climb up the sky; the top note is the sun.

intro.caption: Watch the sun climb up
intro.parentCue: lift your hand slowly as the notes rise

games.caption: Birds are singing sweetly
games.parentCue: Lift your hand with each higher light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a tune climb to its top.

classes.title: Same, same, then new
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and hear the first tune repeat before something new.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same line comes again, then a new line follows

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up one finger for 'same', and wave your hand when the new part starts.
classes.childAction: Play slowly. Say 'same!' or 'new!' at each line.
classes.bridge: Wake up and the sun share one tune; the birds bring a new one.

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing what repeats and what is new.

classes.title: Run-ning, then a long E
classes.goal: Practise the quick C-D into the long E, holding it for three counts.

mathTarget.parentLine: Some notes are quick; the long E lasts three counts

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'run-ning' on the quick notes, then count '1, 2, 3' softly on E.
classes.childAction: Quick, quick, then hold E with finger 3: one, two, three.
classes.bridge: The quick notes are a sunbeam running; the long E is the sun staying up.

intro.caption: Run-ning... and hold!
intro.parentCue: count 1, 2, 3 slowly on the long note

games.caption: C, D, hold E: 1, 2, 3
games.parentCue: Count three while finger 3 holds E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: quick notes and holding a long one.

classes.title: Two big sways
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and evenly, feeling two big sways in each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: This music swings in twos: sway left, sway right

classes.parentPrompt: Sway gently left, then right, beside your child on each big beat.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and evenly while we sway left, right.
classes.bridge: The music is a slow swing in the morning air: left, right, left, right.

games.caption: Tap the two big beats
games.parentCue: Sway left, right with the taps

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly and evenly, in twos.

classes.title: Sunrise up high
classes.goal: Play the first tune from a higher C with the same fingers and hear it match.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same tune still works when the hand moves up

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child find the next C to the right, by its two black keys.
classes.childAction: Move your hand to the high C and play the morning tune.
classes.bridge: High C is the same house up the hill, closer to the sun.

intro.caption: Move up closer to the sun
intro.parentCue: find the next two black keys to the right

games.caption: Hear the morning tune up high
games.parentCue: Ask: is it brighter up here?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same tune in a higher place.

classes.title: Play with the sunrise
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fitting your playing to a speed you did not choose

classes.parentPrompt: Sway beside your child with the music; if notes are missed, keep going and smile.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes? Keep going!
classes.bridge: Grieg wrote this sunrise for a play; now your fingers join it.

intro.caption: The sun is rising, join in!

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music.

classes.title: From sleepy to bright
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, starting soft and growing brighter, like sunrise.

mathTarget.parentLine: Getting a little louder, step by step, not all at once

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; crouch small at the start, then rise slowly as it grows.
classes.childAction: Start soft and sleepy, then play a little brighter each line.
classes.bridge: Soft notes are the first light; brighter notes are the sun all the way up.

intro.caption: A sunrise for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing soft, then brighter, a whole song.
